entries.20bab826401a5ef9: A business of building construction and civil engineering work carried out by SHIMIZU CORPORATION itself through its regional branches and head offices. Main works completed in the fiscal year ended March 2026 include TOKYO DREAM PARK for TV Asahi Corporation, IT tower TOKYO for IT tower TOKYO GK, Mitamachi Terrace for Chuo Nippon Land & Building Co., Ltd., the Binh Khanh Bridge for the Vietnam Expressway Corporation, and the large-scale renovation of the Harachika Power Plant in Nagano Prefecture. Works carried over include TOKYO TORCH Torch Tower (Building B) for Mitsubishi Estate Co., Ltd., the urban redevelopment projects in the Nihonbashi Itchome Naka district and the Toyomi district, the Manila Subway CP101 section for the Government of the Republic of the Philippines, and the Oizumi-minami construction of the main line tunnel of the Tokyo Gaikan Expressway for East Nippon Expressway Co., Ltd.
entries.26984010a2a9c39a: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,057,802 million. entries.35d093d9c92c23de: It undertakes building and civil engineering works from clients and, when work is completed and handed over, records the amount as completed construction revenue within sales. Part of the work is ordered from affiliated companies such as Nihon Doro Co., Ltd., Nihon Fabtech Co., Ltd. and Daiichi Setsubi Kogyo Co., Ltd. In addition, it has an investment and development business that develops real estate for its own leasing or sale, an engineering business for offshore wind and other renewable energy, and a building lifecycle business responsible for building maintenance. In construction, order (contract) value, which is the amount of contracted work, and completed construction revenue recognized as sales in the period are different figures; on a non-consolidated basis for SHIMIZU CORPORATION, order (contract) value for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,898.1 billion, revenue was ¥1,589.5 billion, and carried-over backlog was ¥2,636.9 billion.

entries.3a8891ee75e44b03: This is a collection of businesses not included in reportable segments, comprising the engineering, green energy development and building lifecycle businesses conducted by SHIMIZU CORPORATION itself, and various businesses conducted by subsidiaries other than Nippon Road Co., Ltd. The engineering business handles renewable energy, production facilities for advanced and strategic products, and environmental remediation, and the company says it is focusing on EPC work for offshore wind power facilities and the operation of SEP vessels. The green energy development business is advancing power source development and electricity retail for renewable energy, as well as the development and implementation of the hydrogen utilization technology “Hydro Q-BiC.” The building lifecycle business provides building maintenance and services to extend building lifespans. Among subsidiaries, Milux Co., Ltd. sells and leases construction materials and equipment, SC Machinery Co., Ltd. rents out construction machinery, Shimizu Finance Co., Ltd. lends funds to group companies, and Tama Medical Campus Co., Ltd. and others conduct PFI business for public facilities.

entries.4e01f42361f775d4: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥118,669 million, and ordinary profit was ¥122,324 million.
